##### EventGraph :: SuppressionImmunityDecayTimer   [node 252]
ENTRY SuppressionImmunityDecayTimer(OutputDelegate: delegate)
if (SuppressionImmunityDecayStartTimer >= SuppressionImmunityDecayThreshold):
  bActivelySuppressed = false
  K2_PauseTimerHandle(Handle=TimerHandle_SuppressionStartDecayTimer)
  SuppressionImmunityDecayStartTimer = 0.0
else:
  SuppressionImmunityDecayStartTimer = (SuppressionImmunityDecayStartTimer + SuppressionImmunityTickRate)
